description: This file defines a repository interface for managing DepositAccountOnHoldTransaction entities, providing methods for database operations related to deposit account hold transactions within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: DepositAccountOnHoldTransactionRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for DepositAccountOnHoldTransaction entities, extends JpaRepository and JpaSpecificationExecutor to provide CRUD and specification execution capabilities.

methods.name: findBySavingsAccountAndReversedFalseOrderByCreatedDateAsc
methods.description: Finds a list of DepositAccountOnHoldTransaction entities associated with a specific savings account that are not reversed, ordered ascending by creation date.
